selected_phase1_task: Test exactly one digest lexical-policy boundary: a 64-character uppercase hexadecimal digest against the current lowercase-only identity_bound_payload_digest policy, with one valid lowercase 64-hex sibling and both arrival orders.

precommit_policy.basis: The current role-local mechanism explicitly requires every identity_bound_payload_digest to be exactly lowercase 64-hex before parent aggregation. Normalizing uppercase would change the tested mechanism rather than verify it.

planned_atomic_boundary: For each of exactly two arrival permutations, apply the precommitted lowercase-64-hex lexical check before parent aggregation; malformed uppercase arrival must invalidate the parent attempt, and if the valid sibling was staged first it must be cleared. Do not test any second lexical boundary in this invocation.
exact_continuation_if_interrupted: Fresh-bootstrap authority; reconstruct current own LATEST; if this preflight is readback-valid but no result exists, execute only the precommitted uppercase-hex two-order probe and persist/read back its result before any other leaf.
